Lemma
[Curvature evolution in the moving frame] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0456, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0457 ↗ def:chow-ii-frame-time-vector 1. appf:eq-F.24,appf:eq-F.25\group Ricci-Flow Frame Bundle

On $\mathcal O\mathcal M$, with $B_{abcd}=-R_{aebf}R_{cedf}$, \[ ( abla _t-\Delta )R_{abcd} =2(B_{abcd}-B_{abdc}+B_{acbd}-B_{adbc}), \qquad ( abla _t-\Delta )R_{ab}=2R_{acdb}R_{cd}, \] where $\Delta =\sum _e abla _e abla _e$.
